scripts.script:
local _RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local _ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

game:GetService('Players')

local v3

if _RunService:IsStudio() then
    v3 = require(_ReplicatedStorage.ImGui)
else
    v3 = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://github.com/depthso/Roblox-ImGUI/raw/main/ImGui.lua'))()
end

local v4 = v3:CreateWindow({
    Title = 'Ruzt Script',
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 170),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 70),
})

v4:Center()

local v5 = v4:CreateTab({
    Name = '@CowkaWare',
})

v4:ShowTab(v5)

local v6 = v5:Checkbox({
    Label = 'God Mode',
    Value = false,
})
local v7 = v5:Button({
    Text = 'Instant Proximity Prompts',
})

v5:Label({
    Text = 'Telegram : t.me/CowkaWare | @CowkaWare',
    TextWrapped = true,
    RichText = true,
})

local _LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local u9 = _LocalPlayer.Character or _LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local u10 = nil
local u11 = 1
local u12 = nil

local function u15(p13)
    if p13 and u9 then
        local _HumanoidRootPart = u9:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')

        if _HumanoidRootPart then
            p13.CFrame = _HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
    else
        return
    end
end
local function u17(p16)
    if p16 and u9 then
        if u9:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then
            p16.Position = p16.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1 * u11, 0)

            if tick() % 0.5 < 0.01 then
                u11 = -u11
            end
        end
    else
        return
    end
end
local function u21()
    if u10 then
        u10:Disconnect()
    end

    local _TouchedSafeZone = workspace:FindFirstChild('TouchedSafeZone')

    if _TouchedSafeZone then
        local _SafeGui = _LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('SafeGui')

        if _SafeGui then
            _SafeGui:Destroy()
        end

        local _BillboardGui = _TouchedSafeZone:FindFirstChild('BillboardGui')

        if _BillboardGui then
            _BillboardGui:Destroy()
        end

        _TouchedSafeZone.Size = Vector3.new(5, 10, 5)
        u10 = _RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            u15(_TouchedSafeZone)
            u17(_TouchedSafeZone)
        end)
    end
end
local function u22()
    if u10 then
        u10:Disconnect()

        u10 = nil
    end
end
local function u25()
    if game:GetService('ProximityPromptService') then
        local _ProximityPromptService = game:GetService('ProximityPromptService')

        if fireproximityprompt then
            if u12 ~= nil then
                u12:Disconnect()
            end

            u12 = _ProximityPromptService.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(p24)
                fireproximityprompt(p24)
            end)
        end
    end
end

function v6.Callback(_, p26)
    if p26 then
        u21()
    else
        u22()
    end
end
function v7.Callback(_)
    u25()
end
